compiled_state.title: T2: Implement .debug-active support in check-session-merge-only.sh (GREEN)
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Context
Story: 155a-6b7b-514f-44e8 — extend check-session-merge-only.sh to enforce merge-only when .debug-active is present

## Goal
Extend plugins/dso/scripts/check-session-merge-only.sh to recognize .debug-active marker with an independent DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0 escape hatch and AND-semantics when both markers are present.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## File Impact
| Source File | Action | Test File | Classification |
|---|---|---|---|
| plugins/dso/scripts/check-session-merge-only.sh | modify | tests/hooks/test-check-session-merge-only.sh | needs-modification |
| .test-index | modify | n/a | n/a |

## Implementation Steps
Replace the current script body with the following logic (preserve set -uo pipefail and header comment):

1. Define both markers:
   SPRINT_ACTIVE_MARKER="$REPO_ROOT/.sprint-active"
   DEBUG_ACTIVE_MARKER="$REPO_ROOT/.debug-active"

2. Compute active booleans:
   _sprint_active=0; _debug_active=0
   [[ -f "$SPRINT_ACTIVE_MARKER" ]] && _sprint_active=1
   [[ -f "$DEBUG_ACTIVE_MARKER" ]] && _debug_active=1

3. No markers guard:
   if [[ $_sprint_active -eq 0 && $_debug_active -eq 0 ]]; then exit 0; fi

4. Sprint escape hatch (INDEPENDENT — only clears _sprint_active):
   if [[ $_sprint_active -eq 1 && "${DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE:-}" == "0" ]]; then
     write audit log to $_artifacts_dir/sprint-merge-only-bypass-<timestamp>.log
     _sprint_active=0
   fi

5. Debug escape hatch (INDEPENDENT — only clears _debug_active):
   if [[ $_debug_active -eq 1 && "${DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE:-}" == "0" ]]; then
     write audit log to $_artifacts_dir/debug-merge-only-bypass-<timestamp>.log
     _debug_active=0
   fi

6. If both cleared, allow:
   if [[ $_sprint_active -eq 0 && $_debug_active -eq 0 ]]; then exit 0; fi

7. Merge commit check (unchanged):
   GIT_DIR="$(git rev-parse --git-dir)"
   if [[ -f "$GIT_DIR/MERGE_HEAD" ]]; then exit 0; fi

8. Rejection with mode-specific messages:
   Build _active_modes string from which booleans are still set
   Print ERROR message naming the active mode(s)
   Print per-mode escape-hatch hint lines (only for active modes)
   exit 1

9. Update script header comment:
   - Change description line to mention both .sprint-active and .debug-active
   - Add DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE escape hatch to Exit codes / header docs
   - Add AND-semantics note for dual-marker state

10. Remove RED marker for check-session-merge-only.sh from .test-index

## Acceptance Criteria
- Script header updated to document .debug-active, DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0, and AND-semantics
- .debug-active alone triggers merge-only enforcement
- DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0 bypasses debug enforcement independently (without requiring DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0)
- When both markers present: both DSO_SPRINT_ACTIVE=0 AND DSO_DEBUG_ACTIVE=0 required (AND semantics)
- Existing sprint-active path structurally unchanged (existing 4 tests still pass)
- Each escape hatch writes its own audit log (sprint: sprint-merge-only-bypass-*.log; debug: debug-merge-only-bypass-*.log)
- RED marker removed from .test-index
- All 9 tests (4 original + 5 new) pass
- bash tests/run-all.sh exits 0 (or only other RED tests fail)
- ruff check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
- ruff format --check plugins/dso/scripts/*.py tests/**/*.py passes
